meta.description: Three experiments on the Korean null pronoun, the colloquial overt pronoun kyay and a demonstrative with a noun, each the subject of a target sentence after a context sentence. Experiment 1 rates naturalness with a sole antecedent; Experiment 2 rates naturalness and asks a comprehension question where the gender of a noun picks the subject or the object of the context sentence as antecedent; Experiment 3 rates naturalness and asks for the antecedent where both are of the same gender. Means and percentages are given as printed, and each contrast with the estimate, standard error, z and p-value of the mixed model or Holm-adjusted comparison the paper reports for it. The subject-antecedent shares of earlier studies are those the paper's introduction reports.
